condition: recombinant homomeric Glass9 pore-deletion variant expressed and purified from E. coli
notes: Directed-evolution-derived homomeric pore-deletion variant with a 9-residue deletion. Glass9 retains the canonical T=4 240-mer architecture but exhibits substantially enlarged pores: approximately 21 Å at pentameric vertices and elongated approximately 12 × 35 Å openings at hexameric vertices. Cryo-EM structure PDB 9ZVV / EMD-74892 was determined at 2.40 Å.
